title: AI Surreal Scenes Video - I met a strange man in Paris
description:
Some Saturday surrealism. These are so satisfying for some reason. Surrealism is my favorite style. You can probably tell. I’m completely obsessed with Dali. His art, his style, his face, his voice. He was a genius. I just hope to help keep his art alive. He inspires me so much. Images made using #Midjourney and animated using @HiggsfieldAI  Higgsfield offers many different options of animation apps inside their app. So if one animation doesn’t work you have many other options to try to get the right one. This is such a great app. Highly recommended. Song made using @suno  This song took me two days to get right. I sometimes make 100 versions that I have to listen to before I find one that resonates. This version “felt” good to me. I love this vocal. In Suno if you get a vocal you like you can save it and use it again. That’s a cool feature. Have a beautiful day. 

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aimusic #suno #aiimages #higgsfield #surreal
